description:
Create a 3D mountainous terrain in Blender using procedural displacement.

1. Delete or hide the default cube.
2. Create a highly subdivided ground plane (at least 100x100 cuts / 10,000+ faces).
3. Add a Displace modifier using a procedural texture (Clouds, Musgrave, or Voronoi) to generate mountains. Set strength between 1.0 and 10.0.
4. Apply a terrain material with a natural base color (green/brown, not grey) and high roughness (>0.5).
5. Position the camera for a high-angle aerial view looking down at the terrain (height 5-30m).
6. Render the scene to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/terrain_render.png'.
7. Save the project to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/terrain_scene.blend'.
